title: Mochizuki Honami — How to Spend New Year's Eve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: How to Spend New Year's Eve（4★）

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's getting pretty late.
Isn't it past your bedtime, Miku?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, we get it!! You can stay up, Miku-P!!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Lay off, you two. That's bordering on bullying, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry.
I couldn't help it. They're just so adorable like this.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <As long as you understand... Anyway, I'm next. Mind rolling for me, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. It's a four, which means you have to draw a card. Let's see what it says...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What's it say?
What does she have to do?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Quick conference...
MEIKO, about this card...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hm...? Oh, I see.
I was under the impression that barking was a penalty this whole time. I wasn't expecting this...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we have some questions for you two.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which of these snacks is your favorite, Honami? I'll point to them one at a time, so let us know when... Potato chips, popcorn...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Okay, Miku, you're next.
Do you usually play the guitar, Miku?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Last question.
Is it embarrassing to have to bark like a dog?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Sorry, you two...
We get three treats, right, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mind showing us the card you just drew? Okay, um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Earn three treats by making someone bark three times within thirty seconds.” Now it all makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! There's a card like that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She's right! Does that mean there are more of those?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Fortunately, we only had to bark for a turn, so that's all done and over with.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Darn...!
That sounded like a great way to get some extra treats!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, we made it to the goal.
Pretty sure that we won too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We even got five extra treats for reaching it first.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <A comeback seems pretty tough at this point.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nonsense! We have tons of treats!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! All we need is a card or something that can give us a boost...!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I rolled a three... We're on a card space! C'mon, give us something good! Please!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<No, it's back!
“Bark like your dog's piece until your next turn”...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, isn't it about time we headed over to the shrine? We were hoping that...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... This is Canine Saki and Rin!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was really hoping that you and MEIKO would have to bark like dogs too, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But it was still super duper fun♪
We should have Len and KAITO play next time!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Then, why don't we have them bring it over to SEKAI so we can all play?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was worried that a board game wouldn't be quite what they were hoping for, but I'm really glad they liked it so much.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It was a wonderful way to cap off the year.)
